notable_absence.finding: This landing page is a thin stub: one sentence of body text plus a link to the generated rest_api_public.md reference and a stock 'Related Content' footer block. It carries no access-control content of its own - unlike rest-api-admin.md, it makes no mention of RBAC, authentication, or the fact that the Public REST API's own access model (channels, sgw:user) is entirely different from the Admin/Metrics APIs' reused Server-RBAC model. A reader landing here first would get no signal that three REST APIs on this product use two structurally unrelated authorization systems.
